_how_to: A cover-letter batch (schema_version 2). Letters are optional by default: only write one the posting requires or you asked for. Get each body's hash with: python3 scripts/cover_letter_generator.py --spec <spec> --review-digests, review the actual text (prompts/08_review.md), then paste the review object. A review is tied to normalized body text; edit the body and the review is stale.

claim_checks.source: ledger claim or dated user statement

review.role_match: which of the role's needs this answers and with what evidence
